name: MELAO Retinol Hyaluronic Acid Vitamin E Serum 30ml
description:
Melao Retinol Hyaluronic Acid Vitamin E Serum – 30ml
Age-Defying, Hydrating & Brightening Serum | Made in China

Origin: Made in China 🇨🇳

Key Benefits:

Reduces wrinkles, fine lines, dark spots, pigmentation, and age spots

Improves skin texture and elasticity, promoting a radiant glow

Minimizes pores and helps improve acne-prone skin

Hydrates and nourishes with Hyaluronic Acid, Vitamin E, Aloe & botanical extracts

Suitable for all skin types – oily, dry, or sensitive skin

Active Ingredients:

Retinol (2.5%) – antioxidant that promotes collagen & elastin production, reduces pore size, and prevents visible signs of aging

Hyaluronic Acid – deeply hydrates and plumps skin

Vitamin E & Aloe – soothe and nourish skin
